name: Mossback Hedgehog

clues.school: Small round tracks wander through the mossy ground.
clues.min: The tracks keep to where the moss grows thickest.
clues.find: An Ink Cap has been nibbled, right down to the gills.
clues.time: The tracks are fresh just after dark.

text: A round little hedgehog with moss growing in its prickles. It snuffles for mushrooms in the dark.

name: Lantern Moth

clues.school: Fine glittering dust lies over the glowing ground.
clues.min: The dust gathers where the glow is brightest.
clues.time: The dust is still bright at dusk, as if something just left.

text: A soft moth whose wings hold a little light. It comes when the day is fading.

name: Honey Bumble

clues.school: Pollen lies in little footprints among the flowers.
clues.min: The footprints keep to where the flowers grow thickest.
clues.find: A Meadow Daisy has been nibbled at the edges.
clues.time: The pollen is fresh in the middle of the day.

text: A fat, fuzzy bumble that hums between flowers on warm days.

name: Fern Rabbit

clues.school: Something has made little paths through the long grass.
clues.min: The paths only go where the grass is tallest.
clues.time: The grass on the paths is still bent and wet at dawn.

text: A shy rabbit with fern-green ears. It nibbles the grass in the first light.

name: Prism Beetle

clues.min: The scratches are on the biggest crystals.
clues.find: A Pebble Cap has been nibbled, leaving a glittering rim.
clues.time: The scratches catch the sun at midday, still sharp.

text: A beetle with a shell like cut glass. It basks on crystals in the sun.

name: Mist Fox

clues.school: Light pawprints cross the misty ground and vanish.
clues.min: The pawprints go where the mist lies thickest.
clues.time: The pawprints are fresh at dawn, the mist still settling in them.

text: A small grey fox that seems half made of mist. It slips through at first light.

name: Foxfire Newt

clues.terrain: A trail of tiny handprints winds between the glowing roots of the fen.
clues.time: The handprints glow faintly, fresh in the night.
clues.rain: The handprints are pressed into wet earth after rain.

text: A newt with glowing spots, out on rainy nights where foxfire burns.

name: Petal Stag

clues.terrain: Small hoofprints wander through the moonlit flowers, and the petals are bent.
clues.time: The hoofprints are fresh by moonlight.

text: A tiny stag with flowers in its antlers. It walks only in moonlit gardens.
